why: OpenGL is not a drawing path in a Dawn-painted app: Dawn (WebGPU on Metal or D3D12) draws everything through the painter. A GL call, a GL constant, an OpenGL header or JUCE's OpenGL module or classes brings back a second drawing path the picture gates do not judge (work order F, F7.6, deleted it for good).
